instructions.description: Lie on your back on the floor and raise your feet off the ground so that your knees are at 90 degrees and your shins are parallel with the floor.
Put your hands to the sides of your head.
Bring one knee towards you, touching it to the opposite elbow.
As you bring one leg in, extend the other one straight out into the air in front of you.
Keep alternating opposite knee to elbow, making sure to contract your stomach muscles the whole time.

performanceMetrics.notes: Count repetitions completed with controlled technique.
